title: Showdown Challenges
meta: Every option meets the same learning outcomes
intro: Students enjoy the food challenges most, and we are keen to learn how cooking together shapes their experience. If your school allows it, we encourage Decorate, Bake or Mystery.

rows.note: About 10 min prep: print the cards and worksheets; gather paper and colouring supplies.
About 20 min prep plus shopping: buy cupcakes and frosting the day before; a craft version works if food isn’t possible.
About 30 min prep plus shopping: book the oven and an adult; one small batch per team makes 6 cupcakes. It bakes during clean-up and reflection.
As Bake, plus one twist you choose: a mystery mix-in or a teamwork twist, such as only one student reading the recipe.

blocks.title: Before any food challenge
blocks.text: Check your school’s food rules and every student’s allergies and dietary needs against each label, including cocoa and any mystery ingredient. The recipe has no eggs or dairy but contains wheat flour.
